Uploaded0.9.1 and still-running historical Build20261019.5 are clearly distinguished before activation; refresh action, organized-folder prerequisite and Composer/Library actions are legible and separated.

Full original reviewed. One-column summary, paragraph wrapping and full-width final actions fit390 pixels. Historical running build is expected before activation; no observed horizontal spill or control collision.

Full original reviewed. Current running/uploaded build, completed repair, reversible archive location and follow-up actions fit mobile width. Displayed0 retired files/1 directory is the producer second cleanup pass after it removes its own custom-sibling sentinel; aggregate46 files/25 directories is established by report and source assertions.
Full original reviewed. Authenticator/recovery field, explanatory copy and Confirm owner access button fit the390-pixel viewport with clear separation.
Full original reviewed independently at original resolution. Matches the MFA factor form appearance above byte-for-byte; current repair entry has readable code field and confirmation button.

Full original reviewed. Current uploaded build and historical running0.8.14 Build20261021.3 are distinct before explicit activation. Refresh and navigation actions are legible; organized-root card correctly has no old forwarders.

Full synthetic scene capture reviewed. Checked background, rear pink and front cyan image layers and standalone booking control are visible. Default heading is clipped by the configured scene boundary; this is a constrained geometry/occlusion fixture, not an ordinary public-layout approval image.

Full synthetic canvas capture reviewed. Selection handles, independent image layers and foreground composite are visible. Content and a narrow booking label are clipped in this custom300-pixel-high scene; no claim of typography approval is made from this geometry fixture.

Full synthetic footer scene capture reviewed. Colored foreground/depth layers, main group action and separate booking control remain visible. Default heading extends beyond configured scene top; sample assesses synthetic composite appearance only.

Full synthetic mobile scene capture reviewed. Distinct colored layers and foreground composition are visible; default copy and narrow booking label are clipped within the custom short scene. Retained independent geometric/pixel comparisons establish rendering behavior; this is not a default-page typography check.

Reviewed upper1150 and lower1100 original pixels. Mobile heading/card, visible form controls, explanation cards and footer fit390 pixels. Fixed player covers a band near the initial viewport bottom; review does not classify it as a permanent obstruction or certify all controls unobscured.

Reviewed upper1100 and lower1050 original pixels. Header/navigation, Hero, inquiry/newsletter cards and footer are legible and aligned. The fixed music player is captured once at the initial viewport bottom in the full-page image; this sampling does not establish absence of all overlap while scrolling.

Reviewed upper1200 and lower1200 original pixels. Mobile header, wrapped Hero title, stacked inquiry/newsletter cards and footer/credit links fit390 pixels. The fixed player visibly covers part of the initial Hero copy/actions in the full-page capture; scrolling usability was not independently exercised in this screenshot review.

caveats: Representative visual sample only;561PNG decode integrity is broader than this14-original visual review.
Synthetic depth images visibly clip default text and narrow custom button labels; they test controlled scene projection/occlusion and are not a default-page typography approval.
Fixed music player is present at initial viewport bottom in full-page public captures and can obscure captured content there; screenshots alone do not establish scrolling interaction/accessibility.
No quantitative color contrast or full WCAG certification is claimed.

limitations: This review verifies retained evidence and provenance. It does not rerun tests or claim production deployment; full CI/release decisions remain with the parent gate review.

The installed-update JSON does not embed a producer digest. Binding uses GitHub artifact workflow_run.head_sha, the pinned workflow command and corrected source SHA256 d0264b310de99264be72fed607e318fd5c28fead49543eb0e969c1ca623ae2ba.

The strict authentication-only predicate permits intentional private security-journal writes and an absent paymentJournal becoming exactly []. It does not allow a nonempty journal or unrelated customer-state changes. CI reports contain the predicate result, not raw before/after fixture snapshots.

Three historical warm-cache controls intentionally retain the known old Composer frame error before repair. Unexpected-old error counts and all current post-repair JavaScript error counts are zero; this historical control is not an unexplained current-build failure.

The browser artifact contains PNG, JSON and log files only. Exact Fresh/Upgrade ZIP binding here uses recorded identities and runtime/source-match assertions compared against separately pinned expected package hashes. Actual customer ZIP bytes must be verified in the separate runtime artifact/package review.

Exact package identity is independently compared wherever embedded. Three primary reports and all30 auxiliary geometry files embed no ZIP hash; their isolated JSON cannot establish exact package bytes. Mapped pinned producer hashes are not mislabeled as embedded execution attestations.

All externally_pinned_fresh flags present here are false: producers rebuilt/verified a package and recorded identity; this review independently matches those recorded hashes to the expected candidate. No externally pinned producer invocation is claimed.

Public-layout-audit.json comes from scripts/test_http.sh in a disposable copied runtime with tests/Http/router.php. Its24 observations certify the recorded navigation/footer, decoded-image and horizontal-fit checks; they do not independently certify no-rewrite package behavior or vertical non-overlap.

Parent visual reviewer reports fixed music-player overlays at the initial viewport bottom in full-page public screenshots. This static report does not visually certify those screenshots as unobscured or overlay-free.

Depth fixtures deliberately upload geometric background/cutout PNGs and replace scene positions and heights: hero desktop/tablet/mobile720/600/300, footer420/420/300, custom contentBox{x:3,y:4,width:28,height:28} and custom layer/button geometry. These are pixel/geometry controls, not approved default public-layout captures; headline/button clipping in synthetic scene samples must not be reported as universal no-clipping success.
Depth includes an intentionally missing background image and requires it to fail while hiding the foreground mask; this expected404 is not an unexplained failed application image.
